messages.subject: interaction in path analysis
parts:
Dear lavaan community,

I have a question about modeling interaction in path analysis. I understand interaction from OLS regression, but what I am wondering is how to model the interaction between two endogenous variables in path analysis. Specifically, in my model (see below), I have several antecedents, impacting two mediators, which then influence the outcome. However, I would like to test the interaction between the two mediators. I tried it with OLS regression and it was significant. In path analysis, however, I am not sure whether I should also regress the interaction variable (the product of the two mediators) on the antecedents (and if yes, then which ones, since different antecednets predict different mediators). Any suggestions and recommendations (e.g., books, articles) would be very welcome.

Regards,
Jošt
